s1.syndrome_frame: A chronic, progressive skin lesion with recent increase in size and symptoms
salient_findings: Itchy plaque on the mid-back
Gradual increase in size over 10 years
Occasional oozing of serosanguineous fluid and bleeding
Well-defined erythematous plaque with overlying ulceration
Lichenification of adjoining skin
key_facts: Oozing of serosanguineous fluid and bleeding
Circumscribed tumor contiguous with normal epidermis
Tumor epithelium with multiple papillary projections
Atypical cells, mitotic figures, and areas of necrosis
p63 staining positive in myoepithelial cell layers
Congophilic amorphous eosinophilic deposits in dermal papillae

shortlist.label: Hidradenoma papilliferum
shortlist.why_kept: Circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining and papillary projections, consistent with hidradenoma papilliferum

shortlist.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Atypical cells, mitotic figures, and areas of necrosis within a tumor with apocrine features, raising concern for apocrine gland carcinoma

shortlist.label: Syringoma
shortlist.why_kept: Papillary projections and vascular stroma, which can be seen in syringoma, although less likely given the size and symptoms

shortlist.label: Poroma
shortlist.why_kept: Similarities with poroma, including papillary projections and vascular stroma, but less typical due to the presence of atypical cells and necrosis

shortlist.label: Eccrine gland carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Although less likely, eccrine gland carcinoma can present with similar features, including a circumscribed tumor with papillary projections and atypical cells

raw.rationale: The presence of a circumscribed tumor with multiple papillary projections, vascular and plasma cell-rich stroma, and positive p63 staining in myoepithelial cell layers are characteristic features of Hidradenoma papilliferum. The lack of dermal invasion also supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Apocrine gland carcinoma
rejected.why: Although the tumor shows atypical cells and mitotic figures, the absence of dermal invasion and the overall architecture are not typical of a malignant process like apocrine gland carcinoma.

rejected.label: Syringoma
rejected.why: Syringoma typically presents as multiple small lesions and lacks the complex papillary architecture seen in this case.

rejected.label: Poroma
rejected.why: Poroma is a tumor that originates from the intraepidermal portion of the eccrine gland and typically lacks the apocrine features seen in this case.

rejected.label: Eccrine gland carcinoma
rejected.why: Eccrine gland carcinoma is a malignant tumor that would be expected to show more aggressive features and dermal invasion, which is not seen in this case.
